component.name: VulkanScope Pro
component.summary: Real-time Vulkan CRT phosphor oscilloscope and 3D waterfall mastering analyzer

description.p: VulkanScope Pro is a native, GPU-accelerated audio mastering and analysis suite for Linux built with Rust, Vulkan (wgpu), and PipeWire.

ul.li: 8192-point GPU Compute Shader FFT with logarithmic frequency mapping (20 Hz – 20 kHz) and pink-noise mastering tilt
HDR CRT Phosphor XY Oscilloscope with velocity-modulated electron-beam persistence and 45° Mid/Side vectorscope rotation
Real-time 3D Spectrogram Waterfall with studio lighting, contour markers, 4 color palettes, and HDR bloom
EBU R128 Momentary and Short-Term LUFS, True Peak (dBTP), L/R peak/RMS meters, and Phase Correlation
Lock-free real-time PipeWire capture with live sink and application node switching

description.p: Initial release with PipeWire capture, 8192-point Vulkan Compute FFT, HDR Phosphor XY CRT scope, 3D Waterfall, and EBU R128 mastering meters.
